source: USAF Stability and Control DATCOM (1978 revision), figures 4.3.1.2-11a (with afterbody) and 4.3.1.2-11b (no afterbody), METHOD 1, section 4.3.1.2 C; scan p. 1046 = page 126 of reference/docs/usaf-datcom-1978-dtic-adb072483-pp0921-1350.pdf. Applicability: section 4.3.1.2 C, scan p. 1041 (page 4.3.1.2-6).
quantity: K_B(W) [beta (C_L_alpha)_e (lambda_e + 1) (b/d - 1)] with (C_L_alpha)_e per radian, against v = beta d / c_r_e, for curves of beta cot(Lambda_LE) ('inf' = unswept leading edge)

method.calibration: 11a: x = 954 + 340 v, value = (1474 - y)/136; 11b: x = 955 + 339.75 v, value = (2679.5 - y)/134.9 (page pixels of the 300 dpi render)
method.figure_11a: pass 1 and pass 2 are ordered-dark-run extractions at two different column sets; labels, legend and spurious clusters removed by hand (DROP_A), missing curves listed (MISSING_A); each pass interpolated linearly in v onto the grid; the curve labels between v = 0.45 and 0.6 leave no reading there, so both passes interpolate across that span
method.figure_11b: below v = 0.9: pass 1 by-eye polylines, pass 2 polylines snapped to the drawn line; from v = 0.9: two column extractions (pass 1 at v = 1.2, 1.6, 2.0, 2.4 plus a by-eye column at v = 2.62; pass 2 every 0.2 from 0.9 to 2.7)
method.value: mean of the passes where both read; uncertainty per curve = max(0.05, half the worst disagreement), in ordinate units
method.domain: 11a: v = 0.2 to 3.85. 11b: v = 0.25 to 2.6; the 11b curves start at v = 0.2 and run together above v = 2.7 in the scan
